title: Actually a super lit pool party !
text: Pool party was fun as, easy to get to and it was pumping when we were there. Heaps of people were actually swimming and getting in the pool which was a lit, unlike those parties where nobody actually swims. Definitely worth checking out !
author: benl243

title: Great experience!
text: A different, pleasant and best party approach to enjoy something different in Barcelona. Very good atmosphere!
author: 05kr8891

title: LOOSE
text: We had a staff party in the bus and it was utter madness. Stumbling around a moving bus with your mates is something everyone should do once !!
author: benl243
